profile_text.body:
Celestica is a publicly traded technology company headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, trading under the ticker CLS. It describes itself as a technology leader with expertise in design, engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, and platform solutions, working across what it calls high-growth markets. The company says it engineers, designs, and manufactures the backbone of AI and cloud technology, and that it enables critical data center infrastructure for AI, cloud, and hybrid cloud deployments. It also describes a global network and a team that help customers pursue competitive advantage.

The company's own framing places AI largely on the infrastructure side rather than in end-user software: its stated role is building and supplying the hardware and platform foundations that AI and cloud workloads run on. No specific AI products, models, or services are named in the material available, and no lawsuits or MCP servers are recorded for the company. Its registration details list a CIK of 0001030894.
